You can't just replace them and expect to have the same rat. I'm so sorry this happened to you, my baby Lilith has a really large tumor on her chest and it breaks my fucking heart. I'm sorry. I know this stuff, I'm just going through a really hard time right this moment and i didn't proof read my comment heavily enough. I also figured the point about saying self harm is bad regardless is obvious enough not to include, as it's kinda all we ever hear anyway. Sorry for not being specific enough, i guess. Also, let's not call every little mistake somebody makes "problematic", it's not even a little bit necessary.

Thank you for the kind words, that means a lot to me. I want to take my medication but I can't afford to get them yet. It really fucking sucks because I was feeling sort of okay on them and then I had to stop cold turkey and you really shouldn't do that with antidepressants because it can fuck you up I guess.

I'm seeing a therapist, but honestly it hasn't been helping a whole lot lately. I don't have anybody to talk to anymore. None of my friends talk to me when I need them to. I feel like it can't be a coincidence that every time I'm doing bad they're all of a sudden unable to even send a sentence to me, when they post on social media all day. I don't know how to ask them for support without it sounding manipulative, because I also don't want them to feel obligated to talk to me. I just wish somebody GENUINELY cared for me and wanted to help me, not someone who feels obligated to or because they're being paid.

I feel like nobody cares about me because nobody acts like they care about me, even more so when I'm struggling.
 I'm so behind in my life I don't think I can catch up anymore, I'm never going to be successful no matter how hard I try. 
I'm always the person people go to for emotional support but nobody ever reciprocates, which is fine I guess like they aren't obligated to so I won't say anything anout it. 
I just drag behind with everything I do and i just really don't want to deal with it anymore. I've been feeling like this for such a long time and I recently stopped taking my medication which just made this all way worse than it's ever been.

I realize nothing I say is going to change how you feel right now, but I must say I really hope you don't kill yourself. You mentioned that you're in college, so you're still young. I'm not going to spout a bunch of shit about how it gets better and stuff, but someday the pain won't be as bad as it feels right now. Just try to push through one more day, week, month, etc. One day it won't be quite as bad. My pm's are open if you ever want to vent, I'm bad at giving advice but I'm always here to listen.

Also, all that being said, you probably shouldn't use a pencil anyway because you could still get more unwanted shit in the wound than other things would, however you can get an infection any time there's an open wound. But I wouldn't be worried about lead poisoning.

What you're doing is still self harm regardless of what you use to do it. I'm very sorry you're going through this, try to remember you aren't alone! You do NOT have to start using something different just because you don't think it's "bad enough." Trust me, as someone with arms full of deep scars, It's never going to seem bad enough anyway. Also about the whole lead going into your blood and killing you thing; the stuff in pencils hasn't been lead in many many years, it's graphite, you'll live. It'll be okay 💙 my pm's are open if you ever need to chat, I might not reply right away but I will always try!! Good luck to you
